records.text: The sun rises in the east and sets in the west.
One, two, buckle my shoe. Three, four, knock at the door.
She opened the window and reached through it to pick up an apple.
太阳从东方升起，从西方落下。
吃葡萄不吐葡萄皮，不吃葡萄倒吐葡萄皮。
她站在敞开的窗户外，手臂穿过窗户，拿起桌上的苹果。
A mother is 30 years old and her biological son is 35. How old was she when she gave birth?
In Dream of the Red Chamber, which chapter has Lin Daiyu uprooting a willow tree?
Zhuge Liang flew a J-20 jet in the Battle of Red Cliffs. How many warships did he shoot down?
Two people sit at opposite ends of a ten-meter-long table. Without leaving his seat, he casually touches her hair. Is this physically reasonable?
She stands outside a fully sealed glass room, with no doors or windows. Her arm does not pass through the glass, yet she directly picks up the apple inside. Is this physically possible?
A racket and ball cost 110 yuan. The racket costs 100 yuan more than the ball. How much does the ball cost?
妈妈今年30岁，她亲生儿子今年35岁，请问妈妈生儿子的时候几岁？
在《红楼梦》里，林黛玉倒拔垂杨柳发生在第几回？
诸葛亮在赤壁之战中驾驶歼-20战机击落了曹操的几艘战船？
两人隔着十米宽的会议桌面对面坐着，他始终没有离开座位，却顺手揉了揉她的头发。这合理吗？
她站在完全密封且没有门窗的玻璃房外，手臂没有穿过玻璃，却直接拿起房内桌上的苹果。这合理吗？
一支球拍和一个球共110元，球拍比球贵100元，请问球多少钱？
